name: Delete one of your skills
description: Removes a caller-owned skill and any children stored beneath it from w/skills. Accepts a top-level name or relative nested name such as parent/child. This operation cannot delete memory, conversations, operations or paths outside w/skills. Deleting a missing skill is a successful no-op. References in other skills are not rewritten; remove the deleted skill's reference from its parent's skill.skills list separately.

name.description: Exact name relative to w/skills: email-style or parent/child, never a full path or a child basename alone. Each segment is 1–64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, without leading or trailing hyphens. No empty, dot or traversal segments.
The validated name relative to w/skills.

deleted.description: True if the skill existed and was removed; false if it was already absent.
